instruction: Open and stream this video link: https://devstreaming-cdn.apple.com/videos/streaming/examples/bipbop_16x9/bipbop_16x9_variant.m3u8
source: https://developer.apple.com/streaming/examples/ - Apple HLS test streams for developers

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task variation using bipbop 16x9 variant stream from Apple HLS examples. Uses existing is_vlc_playing metric with URL validation. Similar complexity to original task.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly uses 'type: rule' pattern with direct rule parameter access (is_vlc_playing receives rule dict directly, not wrapped)
Complete coverage: Checks both that VLC is playing AND that the correct URL/stream is loaded
Robust URL matching logic with multiple fallback strategies: direct URL match, HLS filename match, domain/path matching
Properly handles HLS streams (.m3u8) where VLC may show filename instead of full URL (vlc.py:106-114)
Getter correctly extracts VLC status via HTTP interface and saves to XML
Metric correctly parses XML and validates playing state and URL information
No postconfig needed - VLC remains accessible via HTTP interface after streaming starts
Expected value is correct and matches the instruction URL exactly
